subject: Live walkthrough blocked by onboarding/ NDA — propose async exec highlight + technical pre-brief
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Sara Li <sara.li@prodmed.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 28 May 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Intro call + live walkthrough next week — vendor onboarding items

Hi Sara —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. We penciled in a 45-minute live walkthrough for Wed 3 June at 10am PT to go through Redwood inference for your API use case and show the Dedicated routing examples. Before the live session, our procurement/security team has requested a few items:

- Signed NDA (we use DocuSign)
- Completed vendor security questionnaire (I attached our standard onboarding checklist and your questionnaire copy)
- Confirmation of SSO/IDP attributes for sandbox access

If you can get the NDA started and the questionnaire back, we can ensure the right infra folks are present for the live technical demo. If procurement needs more time or prefers to validate first, happy to offer an alternate plan (exec-highlight recording + a focused technical pre-brief once portal intake is complete).

Next steps I suggest:
1) I’ll send a DocuSign NDA link this morning (Ben — can you please share the standard NDA template?)
2) Sara — if you can circulate the procurement contact who owns the questionnaire we’ll coordinate follow-up
3) If the exec team is traveling, we can produce a short 8–10 minute recorded highlight tailored to your senior stakeholders and then schedule the hands-on tech session after intake is cleared

Attaching: redwood_vendor_onboarding_checklist.pdf (checklist), prodmed_security_questionnaire.xlsx (your copy).

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Sara Li <sara.li@prodmed.com>

Date: Thu, 28 May 2026 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro call + live walkthrough next week — vendor onboarding items

Hi Neha —

Thanks for the recap and the checklist. Quick update from our side: procurement has flagged the vendor questionnaire and SSO integration details as gating items — they need answers before the platform security team will allow a live exec-facing demo. Also, two of our exec sponsors (CTO + Head of ML) are traveling 1–7 June, so the originally penciled Wed 3 June slot is going to be tough for them.

Options we’re considering:
- Push the live walkthrough until after the questionnaire + NDA are complete (likely mid-June earliest), or
- Accept a recorded executive highlight for the execs now and schedule a technical hands-on demo for the engineers once intake is closed

Procurement asked whether Redwood can provide a brief recorded deck or a short recording of a 10-minute executive highlight that we can share internally. If you can also confirm who on your side would join the technical session (for engineering/architect-level questions), that helps us coordinate the intake.

I’ll copy the procurement lead to coordinate the questionnaire turnaround.

Thanks,
Sara Li
Senior Product Manager, Integrations
ProdMed

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Sara Li <sara.li@prodmed.com>
Date: Thu, 28 May 2026 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro call + live walkthrough next week — vendor onboarding items

On Thu, May 28, 2026 at 11:18 AM Sara Li <sara.li@prodmed.com> wrote:
> Procurement has flagged the vendor questionnaire and SSO integration details as gating items — they need answers before the platform security team will allow a live exec-facing demo.
> Also, two of our exec sponsors (CTO + Head of ML) are traveling 1–7 June, so the originally penciled Wed 3 June slot is going to be tough for them.

Thanks for the note, Sara — understood. Neha and I chatted offline and propose the following pragmatic path that keeps momentum without exposing your execs to a deep technical session before intake is complete:

1) Exec highlight: We’ll produce a concise 8–12 minute recording (talking points + short demo clips) that you can circulate to the CTO and Head of ML. We’ll include a brief transcript and a bullet summary of architectural fit. Expected turnaround: 3 business days.

2) Technical pre-brief (live, 60 minutes): Once the questionnaire is returned and sandbox SSO is provisioned, schedule a hands-on session for your engineering and security teams. Proposed slots (tentative):
   - Tue 16 June 10:00–11:00 PT
   - Thu 18 June 13:00–14:00 PT

3) NDA/DocuSign: Neha, I’ve attached the standard NDA and can kick DocuSign. Procurement — if you prefer a counter-signed copy, we can accept it and route to legal.

4) Deliverables and owners:
   - Redwood: exec highlight recording + transcript (Ben)
   - ProdMed: completed questionnaire + SSO claim names (Sara / procurement)

If those dates won’t work, we can be flexible — the goal is to avoid a long pause while procurement runs its checks.

Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
(646) 555-0199

Thanks both — that plan sounds good and should keep momentum. Action items we’ll take on our side:

- I will send the DocuSign NDA link to ProdMed procurement this afternoon (DocuSign template: https://www.docusign.com/templates/nda/redwood_standard_2026).
- Ben will produce the 8–12 minute exec highlight and a short bullet transcript; we’ll deliver by Tue 2 June.
- Procurement — can you confirm the questionnaire owner and an estimated return date? If you can complete the attached prodmed_security_questionnaire.xlsx by 10 June, we’ll target the technical pre-brief for Tue 16 June 10:00–11:00 PT (Ben) — otherwise we’ll pick the next mutually available slot.

If a live exec slot opens (exec travel changes), we can still pivot, but this gives your stakeholders material to review while intake completes.
